title: Audi Trainee Sales Executive
description:
About the role

A fantastic opportunity is available for a Trainee Sales Executive to join our team at Reading Audi.

As a Sytner Trainee Sales Executive, you will be the first point of contact for customers by initiating conversation and building rapport to excite them about the brand. You will promote the benefits and unique selling points of Audi, accessories and vehicle ownership.

This is a full-time role which can typically include weekends to ensure we provide our customers with the highest possible levels of service.

About you

Ideally, you will have previous experience of working in retail and be able to maintain exceptional customer care in a competitive environment.

A passion for delivering excellent customer service is a key attribute of the position, along with a determination to expand your knowledge and inspire others; you will demonstrate enthusiasm and self-motivation to excel in customer service. We offer extensive training to allow you to develop expert knowledge of the Audi.

This role is a fantastic opportunity for those who enjoy meeting people and working for a prestige brand in a highly successful and motivated team.

A full and valid UK driving license would be beneficial / preferred.

When applying for this role please consider that we require candidates to have obtained GCSE grade A -C/9-4 or Functional Skills Level 2 (or equivalent) in the following subjects, English, Maths and 1 other subject as a threshold level of qualification.

Sytner Group are delighted to provide an industry-leading benefits package.

We are passionate about continuous improvement and building an environment where everyone feels valued, appreciated and able to reach their full potential.
- Enhanced Holiday Entitlement - 33 days inc. bank holidays
- Industry-leading Maternity, Paternity and Adoption Pay
- Career Development
- Recognition of Long Service every 5 years
- Discounted Car Schemes
- High Street Discounts
- Discounted Gym memberships
- Cycle to work scheme
- One day a year paid voluntary / community work

At Sytner, our values and the way we behave are important to us. We are committed to creating an equitable working environment where we value and respect every individual's unique contribution, supporting our colleagues to thrive and achieve their full potential.

As part of our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion, you have the right to ask for changes / adjustments to job interviews and the recruitment process. For more information around reasonable adjustments and the recruitment process please .

We represent over 23 of the world's most prestige vehicle brands, across our 140 UK dealerships.

We pride ourselves on 'Developing Talent and 'Building Careers' and our colleagues recently scored Sytner Group an outstanding 89% on our colleague engagement survey.

title: New Business Sales Executive IT Solutions & Consulting
description:
Job Title: New Business Sales Executive - IT Solutions & Consulting

Location: Reading (Hybrid)

Salary: £50,000 - £60,000 Base Salary + Uncapped OTE & Benefits

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

About the Opportunity

Thames 360 Limited is delighted to be partnering with a global leader in IT Service Management (ITSM), consulting, and professional training solutions to find their next high-calibre sales professional.

Our client has a rich history of pioneering industry frameworks and a reputation for excellence, helping enterprise businesses transform their corporate operations and technology environments. We are working closely with them to expand their Reading-based commercial team and are looking for a New Business Sales Executive to drive revenue growth.

The Role

As a New Business Sales Executive, you will focus on hunting and securing new enterprise accounts across the UK and EMEA markets, while strategically capitalising on warm inbound leads. This is a hybrid position that perfectly balances consultative phone/virtual engagement with face-to-face client pitches.

Key Responsibilities

Pipeline Generation: Proactively identify, map, and target new business opportunities within mid-market and enterprise corporate accounts.

Consultative Selling: Understand complex client challenges and position our client's bespoke IT training, frameworks, and consulting services as the definitive solution.

End-to-End Sales Management: Manage the entire sales cycle from initial cold/warm outreach and discovery calls to leading high-impact presentations and closing the deal.

Collaboration: Work closely with our client's technical consultants and delivery teams to ensure tailored solutions meet exact requirements.

What Our Client Is Looking For

Proven B2 B Sales Track Record: A minimum of 3+ years of successful business-to-business sales experience, ideally within IT services, SaaS, consulting, or professional corporate training.

Framework Knowledge: Familiarity with modern operational frameworks (such as ITIL, SIAM, or general ITSM) is highly advantageous, though not strictly mandatory.

Strong Communicator: An exceptional relationship builder with a consultative, listener-first approach to sales who can confidently pitch to C-suite decision-makers.

Driven Mindset: A self-motivated "hunter" mentality with a passion for smashing targets and maximizing uncapped commission structures.

What's on Offer

Competitive base salary up to £60,000 (dependent on experience).

Generous, transparent, and uncapped commission structure.

Hybrid working model based out of modern offices in Reading.

Clear internal progression pathways and comprehensive solution training.

Corporate benefits package, including pension and wellness perks.

To Apply: Please submit your CV to the team at Thames 360 Limited today for immediate consideration.

title: Technical Presales Consultant
description:
Getting a technical solution right from the start can make all the difference between a project that runs smoothly and one that runs into problems. As a Technical Presales Consultant, you'll have the opportunity to shape complex data centre projects, win customer confidence and take ownership of delivery from initial discussions through to final handover.

This is a genuinely varied position, split approximately 50/50 between technical pre-sales and project delivery. You'll work directly with customers to understand their requirements, develop practical solutions and ensure projects are delivered successfully.

You'll be joining a specialist physical IT infrastructure services business, working closely with an established five-person team and reporting directly to the COO.

What's in it for you
- £70,000 - £80,000 basic salary, depending on experience.
- Additional earning potential through a bonus/commission scheme.
- Hybrid working arrangements, with regular office attendance in Bracknell and travel to customer sites across the UK.
- A varied role combining technical pre-sales, customer engagement and hands-on project delivery.
- Direct access to the COO, with the opportunity to influence how projects are scoped, priced and delivered.
- Exposure to a wide range of physical IT infrastructure projects, including data centre relocations, hardware installations, structured cabling and decommissioning.

Your responsibilities as Technical Presales Consultant
- Work alongside the sales team to understand customer requirements, conduct site surveys and identify practical technical solutions.
- Develop accurate estimates, scopes of work and technical proposals that support successful bids and customer commitments.
- Manage infrastructure projects from initial planning through to completion, maintaining control of budgets, resources and delivery schedules.
- Coordinate engineers, suppliers and subcontractors to ensure installations, relocations and decommissioning projects are delivered successfully.
- Identify technical and operational risks early, maintaining clear customer communication throughout the project lifecycle.
- Share your pre-sales knowledge with colleagues, supporting their development in customer discovery, technical scoping and estimating.

What we're looking for in a Technical Presales Consultant
- Demonstrable technical pre-sales experience, including customer discovery, solution design, scoping, estimating and supporting successful bids.
- Strong practical knowledge of physical IT infrastructure within live data centre environments, including rack-and-stack, cabling and hardware installations.
- Experience independently managing technical infrastructure projects, including budgets, resources, suppliers and delivery risks.
- Background within an IT infrastructure services provider, systems integrator, technology vendor or a similar technical environment.
- Experience working directly with customers, translating technical requirements into commercially viable proposals and deliverable project plans.

Working hours: Full-time, with hybrid working, regular attendance at the Bracknell office and travel to customer sites across the UK. Specific working hours to be confirmed.

If you've built your career around physical IT infrastructure and enjoy both winning technical projects and seeing them delivered successfully, this could be the ideal next step. Apply today to find out more about this Technical Presales Consultant opportunity.
